scripts.test:unit: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/app -w /app -e COMPOSER_VENDOR_DIR=vendor-test composer:2 install --no-interaction --quiet && docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/app -w /app php:8.2-cli vendor-test/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml
scripts.test:unit:coverage: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/app -w /app -e COMPOSER_VENDOR_DIR=vendor-test composer:2 install --no-interaction --quiet && mkdir -p coverage && docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/app -w /app php:8.2-cli sh -c 'pecl install pcov >/dev/null && docker-php-ext-enable pcov && vendor-test/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml --coverage-text --coverage-clover coverage/clover.xml'
